prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-fashion editorial magazine cover titled URBAN ÉLAN in bold vertical serif typography on the left, with small VOLUME IX and WINTER text across the top. A cinematic black-and-white portrait of a clearly adult modern woman with a confident poised expression, short windswept dark hair, sharp black cat-eye sunglasses, and a sleek black high-neck sleeveless top. Position her in a three-quarter portrait turned slightly in profile against a modern architectural facade with diagonal window geometry. Use diffused daylight from camera-left with subtle negative fill, sculpted monochrome shadows, crisp sunglasses silhouette, gentle hair movement, an 85mm lens, high micro-contrast, natural skin texture, fine monochrome film grain, controlled highlights, and clean legible typography.
